easing.$description: Components must also respect prefers-reduced-motion (see global styles).

out.$description: Entering elements and anything that responds to the user. Strong ease-out: fast start.

in-out.$description: Elements that move or morph on screen (tab indicator).

popup.$description: Starting scale of anchored popups (menu, select, popover). Never scale(0).

modal.$description: Starting scale of dialogs, which stay centered.
